information.description:
A triple-B version of your typical security guard: Bigger, badder, and beefier. They aren’t generally that much more skilled than their thinner underlings, but they’ve got an easier time withstanding a few bullets and don’t pull their punches.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Generics).
